mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in FEDFUNDS above 4% in the month preceding the prediction triggers a forward discounting effect, lowering required returns and pushing S&P 500 20-day forward returns positive.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS > 4.0 for 3 consecutive months prior to prediction
regime_hint: tightening phase after a rate hike cycle
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are non-positive despite sustained FEDFUNDS > 4.0 for 3 months prior.

mechanism_narrative: Rising monthly PAYEMS accompanied by UNRATE below 5% signals labor market softening, which reduces investor confidence and produces negative S&P 500 60-day forward returns.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in >70% of similar labor softening events.

mechanism_narrative: A consecutive monthly rise in HOUST above 2000 units indicates strengthening consumer demand, which elevates earnings expectations and drives positive S&P 500 5-day forward returns.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative despite sustained HOUST > 2000 for 4 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp contraction in INDPRO below 118.5 (2017 index) suggests supply-side pressures, raising uncertainty and pushing S&P 500 20-day forward returns negative.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in >50% of INDPRO contraction episodes.

mechanism_narrative: CPIAUCSL rising by more than 2% over the prior quarter signals accelerating inflation, prompting the Fed to hold rates steady but reducing future growth expectations and producing negative 20-day forward returns.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive when CPIAUCSL rises >2% in prior quarter.

mechanism_narrative: A sudden drop in UNRATE below 4.5% coincides with a surge in PAYEMS, indicating a shift from labor market tightening to easing, which boosts equity valuations and drives positive 60-day forward returns.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline in similar transitions (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Consecutive monthly declines in GDPC1 of over 2% suggest weakening business demand, which compresses earnings growth forecasts and results in negative 5-day forward returns.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive despite GDPC1 declines >2% for 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained RSAFS below 350 million for two consecutive months indicates weak industrial activity, raising risk premia and producing negative 20-day forward returns.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive when RSAFS remains below 350 for 2 months.
